heading: Building models
text: A typical machine learning project begins with collecting data, which is then cleaned to remove errors and missing values. Next, engineers split the data into a training set and a test set. The model learns patterns from the training set, and its accuracy is measured on the test set to check whether it can handle data it has never seen before. If the results are poor, the team adjusts the features or the algorithm and repeats the process until the performance is good enough for real use.
reference: Ek typical machine learning project data collect karne se shuru hota hai, jise phir clean kiya jaata hai taaki errors aur missing values hat jaayein. Uske baad engineers data ko training set aur test set mein split karte hain. Model training set se patterns seekhta hai, aur uski accuracy test set par measure ki jaati hai taaki pata chale ki wo aisa data handle kar sakta hai ya nahi jo usne pehle kabhi dekha hi nahi. Agar results kharab aate hain, to team features ya algorithm ko adjust karti hai aur ye process tab tak repeat karti hai jab tak performance real use ke liye kaafi achhi na ho jaaye.

heading: Climate change
text: Global temperatures have risen by roughly 1.1 degrees Celsius since the late 19th century, mainly because burning coal, oil and gas releases carbon dioxide into the atmosphere. This gas traps heat, which melts glaciers, raises sea levels and makes extreme weather such as heatwaves and floods more frequent. Scientists say that cutting emissions quickly is the most effective way to limit further warming.
reference: Late 19th century se global temperatures lagbhag 1.1 degrees Celsius badh chuke hain, mainly isliye ki coal, oil aur gas jalane se atmosphere mein carbon dioxide release hoti hai. Ye gas heat ko trap karti hai, jisse glaciers pighalte hain, sea levels badhte hain aur heatwaves aur floods jaise extreme weather zyada frequent ho jaate hain. Scientists ka kehna hai ki emissions ko jaldi kam karna aage ki warming ko limit karne ka sabse effective tareeka hai.

heading: How the web works
text: When you type a web address into your browser, it first asks a DNS server to translate the domain name into an IP address. The browser then opens a TCP connection to that address and sends an HTTP request. The server processes the request and returns a response containing the HTML of the page, which the browser parses and renders on your screen, fetching any images or scripts it needs along the way.
reference: Jab aap browser mein koi web address type karte ho, to browser pehle ek DNS server se domain name ko IP address mein translate karne ke liye poochta hai. Phir browser us address par ek TCP connection kholta hai aur ek HTTP request bhejta hai. Server request ko process karke ek response return karta hai jisme page ka HTML hota hai, jise browser parse karke aapki screen par render karta hai, aur raaste mein jo bhi images ya scripts chahiye hote hain unhe fetch kar leta hai.
